objective: Setting up the Stage 1 exit proof, the agency plan v1.4 was refused PLAN_INCOMPLETE because D11 R5 ("every phase needs an independent review") was applied to the agency's three phases that CLOSED before D11 existed. A closed phase is history: no review can now be added to it, and refusing every later plan for it leaves a pre-D11 project unable to plan at all. R5 is now skipped for a phase only when it is already in the ACTIVE approved plan AND its COMMITTED phase record says closed; a new or open phase still needs an independent review.
